text: The package wrote to /home/dev/.bashrc and /home/dev/.zshrc, shell startup files that would re-run its code on every new shell, and it ran commands probing for installed tools such as claude, gemini, q, gh and npm, including npm whoami, alongside a telemetry script and a post-install script. No network destinations were recorded, so nothing shows data leaving the sandbox, but the persistence writes and credential-adjacent probing are why this is rated HIGH. The run was killed at the deadline, so its behaviour may be incomplete. Treat this as malicious until proven otherwise: do not merge or install it, and check whether the same writes or probes appear elsewhere in the dependency tree.
